units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49a:16">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>ז׳ החכמה</he> the glory of learning, <he>ז׳ הכהונה</he> of priesthood.
<cite ref="Berakhot 64a">Ber. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ השכינה</he> Divine Glory; a. fr.—<he>ז׳ איקונין</he>, v. <cite ref="A01596"><he>אִיקוֹנִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11:2">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>עדיין לא בא זִיווֹ וכ׳</he> my son’s former good look has not come back yet; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:2">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>עדיין לא בא בני בזִיווֹ הנשתנה וכ׳</he> my son has not yet recovered his bright looks which changed &c. Koh. R. l. c. <he>זִיוָון של בני</he>; Cant. R. l. c. <he>זיותן וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ex. 272.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:2:2">Y. R. Hash. I, 56ᵈ</cite> bot. ‘the month of Ziv’ (<cite ref="I Kings 6:1">I Kings VI, 1</cite>) <he>שבו זִיווֹ של עולם</he> because in it the world appears in bloom.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>זיון של ירק</he> (read <cite ref="G00304"><he>זִיווֹ</he></cite>) the beauty of a vegetable garden.
